ruleDefinitions.name: DLL Loaded via CertOC.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user installs certificates by using CertOC.exe to loads the target DLL file.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certoc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertOC\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-LoadDLL\\ .*"))
